## 6. Ralph Instructions

```
OBJECTIVE: Implement the feature described in this PRD.
PROGRESS_FILE: docs/prd/progress/[FEATURE_NAME]_progress.md
METHOD: Process tasks sequentially. After each task:
  1. Write/modify the code.
  2. Run: npx next build (for the target app).
  3. If build fails, fix and retry (max 3 attempts).
  4. Commit with message: "feat([app]): [task description]"
  5. Update progress file — mark task complete.
  6. Move to next task.
COMPLETION: Output <promise>COMPLETE</promise> when all tasks pass.
ON_FAILURE: Document failure in progress file. Retry with fix. Escalate after 3 failures.
```
